'''The Elite''' was one of the more luxurious [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After being destroyed during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|invasion]], they were quick to rebuild and open its doors once again soon after. Located along [[Skylane 4467]] in the heart of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], The Elite was caught in a [[Coruscant terrorist attacks and riots|terrorist attack]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] done in support of the movement for [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] independence. Planting a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] in the hotel, the terrorist managed to kill 634 civilians, including himself. The event was covered on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], polarizing [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in the growing [[Second Galactic Civil War|upheaval]] between [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

This attack led to anti-Corellian sentiments among the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]], who retaliated by desecrating the [[Corellian Sanctuary]] on Coruscant. This attack also was one of the factors leading to the creation of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] and the internment of hundreds of Corellian citizens living on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]].
